[CRITICAL] VULNERABLE-VERSION: CVE-2026-123007: Memory corruption in HTTP/2 flow control (nginx.org: major, CVSSv4 9.2, CWE-191)
  evidence: installed version 1.30.6 (stable branch) in vulnerable range 1.9.5-1.31.8
  evidence: conf.d/mcp.conf:3 listen 443 ssl http2
  mitigation: upgrade to 1.30.7 (stable branch), then full restart (`sudo systemctl restart nginx`, not reload) and verify with `nginx -v`. If you cannot upgrade now: `http2 off;` and remove `http2` from `listen` lines, then reload. Advisory: https://my.f5.com/manage/s/article/K000163926
